I’ve been waiting for you, champ in the making!\c
Lt. Surge here is the Gym Leader in this city.
He’s an expert on Electric-type Pokémon and
a real tough guy!\c
Flying- and Water-type Pokémon don’t do well
matched up against Electric types.\c
You’ll also want to watch out so your Pokémon
don’t get stuck paralyzed!\c
And here’s my last tip...\c
Lt. Surge is the cautious type.
He’s put barriers between himself and the rest of
this room, so it won’t be easy getting to him.
Whew!\c\nThat match was electric!\nIt was so blinding—I’m still seeing stars!
